source: These mechanisms interact. High occupancy increases the pool of warps that can contribute TLP. Rich ILP can reduce the number of resident warps required to keep pipelines busy. This is one reason low occupancy is not automatically slow. ZXNAME0000XZ’s Best Practices Guide explicitly notes that sufficient ILP can sometimes cover latency even at lower occupancy.[2]
zh: 这些机制相互作用。高占用率会增加可贡献 TLP 的扭曲池。丰富的 ILP 可以减少保持管道繁忙所需的常驻扭曲数量。这是低入住率不会自动变慢的原因之一。 ZXNAME0000XZ 的最佳实践指南明确指出，即使在较低的占用率下，足够的 ILP 有时也可以覆盖延迟。[2]
